profile:
### Street Rat (“Pouch Pony”) — G4

**Who:** This gold-toothed Manehattan Earth-pony trader sells Pinkie Pie a star-speckled rock pouch for Maud's pet rock, Boulder, but demands **Pinkie's party cannon** in exchange. Maud later gets the cannon back after Rarity dramatically interprets her intimidatingly calm stare. He appears in *Friendship Is Magic*, S6E3, “The Gift of the Maud Pie” (April 2, 2016). [Episode synopsis](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt5524246/plotsummary/)

**Recognize him:** Pale cream-yellow coat, swept two-tone gray-purple mane and tail, blue eyes, a gold tooth, gold earring and medallion, stubble, coral-pink shirt, brown belt, and **six gold coins** as his cutie mark. [Visual color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/95-Street-Rat)

**Names and voice:** The television end credits identify him as **Pouch Pony**, voiced by **James Higuchi**; he speaks several lines, including refusing a refund. **Street Rat** is a community-used name, not spoken in the episode. Its original naming authority is uncertain: one artist's caption claims a “Pie Sisters' Surprise Day” source, which I could not independently verify. [Episode voice credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_six) · [Dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Gift_of_the_Maud_Pie) · [Fan-art gallery](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2024/06/newbie-artist-training-grounds-xiv-day_27.html?hl=en)

**Continuity:** This is a speaking supporting character in the G4 television continuity, not a disguise or alter ego. No other episode, film, or comic appearance was independently confirmed.
